# Alonzo

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Alonzo is described as a nice, manly fellow. He notably possesses a classic nose, which is considered a dependable feature in the family.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)_

## History

Alonzo is one of Philippa Gordon's suitors back in her hometown. Alongside her other suitor, [Alec](../character/alec.md), he woos [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) when [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits her homestead in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P41](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0041), [v3 ch.Lady P49](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0049), [v3 ch.Lady P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 ch.Lady P51](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0051), [v3 ch.Lady P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 ch.Lady P55](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0055), +171 more_

## Relationships

### [Alec](../character/alec.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alonzo and [Alec](../character/alec.md) are rival suitors competing for the affections of [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) in their hometown of [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Both young men actively pursue [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), placing them in direct competition as she indecisively weighs her options between them.

- Rival of — rival suitors for Phil Gordon  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Speaks P5](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0005)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alonzo--phil-gordon.md)

Alonzo is one of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's devoted suitors back in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) whom she considers a dear friend. Although [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) openly longs to see him and considers the possibility of marriage, she remains indecisive about her romantic feelings, continuing to entertain both Alonzo and his rival [Alec](../character/alec.md).

- Friend of — dear boys from Bolingbroke she is longing to see  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>
- Romantically involved with — suitor she is considering marrying  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), +3 more</sub>
